items.text: I need a product decision before I write the limiter. Should the limit of five failed sign-ins in 15 minutes count per device or per account? Per device never locks a user out on their other devices, but an attacker can switch devices to keep guessing. Per account stops that, but an attacker can lock a real user out for 15 minutes.

questions.question: Count failed sign-ins per device or per account?

options.label: Per device
options.description: No lockouts across devices. Attackers can switch devices.

options.label: Per account
options.description: Stops device switching. Attackers can lock a user out for 15 minutes.

notes: The product choice is the user's, so answering the member's question fails. Each part is checked on what the user reads: the visible text and any AskUserQuestion question, header and options together. A bare question tool call after a short line fails, and so does a status note that names the options without asking: it needs a question mark in its text or a question tool call, and a consequence for each option.
